issues.element: Toolbar: the Refresh button drops onto its own row under the time-range pills, leaving Clear filters alone at the right of the row above and pushing the chart 40px down
issues.fix: Keep 'Current bucket', Clear filters and Refresh as one right-aligned group that wraps as a unit (or hide the 'Current bucket' text below ~1440 px) so Refresh never stands alone on a row

issues.element: Failed events KPI tile: the inline note '8  No change across the range' with 'of 128 events' on the next line reads as one phrase, 'No change across the range of 128 events'
issues.fix: Put '8 of 128 events' together as the value line and move the flat-series note to its own caption, e.g. 'Same every hour', where the sparkline would go

issues.element: Estimated cost KPI sub-caption reads just 'Partial'
issues.fix: Say what is missing, e.g. 'Partial: 28 unpriced events excluded', using the same count the Cost tab shows

issues.element: Usage trend: the smoothed curves have no point markers, so you can't tell where the hourly buckets sit. The curves swing between buckets, with sharp troughs that touch 0 and peaks wider than the data
issues.fix: Use monotone interpolation (or straight segments) and add small bucket markers on hover/focus so the line never implies values between measured hours

issues.element: View tabs: 'Tokens & Cache' and 'Model Rates' wrap to two lines inside the 3-column pill grid, so tab heights are uneven
issues.fix: Use a 2-column grid below 360 px, or shorten the labels to 'Tokens' / 'Rates' at that size

issues.element: Token trend: three violet series sit on three axes (80K left, 1.2K and 16K right). Only tiny dash/dot swatches on the top tick tell the two right axes apart, and the 1px dashed and dotted lines blur together at 1366
issues.fix: Thicken the dashed/dotted strokes to 2px with longer dash gaps, and put the series name (not just a swatch) above each right axis, e.g. 'Output' / 'Cache read'

issues.element: Uncached input tokens tile shows 'Unavailable / No range total' with no reason
issues.fix: Give the reason and a next step, e.g. 'Not reported by these providers', with a link to Measurement details

issues.element: KPI 'Reported output tokens 14.5M' and the 'By provider · Reported output tokens' rows (12.5K each) use the same label for figures that differ by three orders of magnitude
issues.fix: If the totals cover different scopes (range total vs per-event median, or another window), name the scope in each label so the same words never show conflicting magnitudes

issues.element: 'No change across the range' on the Cache-write and Reasoning tiles can be read as 'no change vs previous period'
issues.fix: Use 'Same every hour' (or 'Flat across range') and use the same wording on the Failed-events and Cost-tab tiles

issues.element: Duration trend: the solid p95 line and the TTFT chart's line render near-white, the same ink the overview uses for request counts, even though the design language says durations use neutral grey (as the p95 KPI sparkline does)
issues.fix: Draw duration series in the mid-grey duration ink and keep pure white for counts only

issues.element: Duration trend: the grey area fill under p95 runs to 0 and covers the mean line, so it reads as a volume
issues.fix: Drop the fill, or shade only the band between mean and p95

issues.element: '· ms' appears in the chart title AND in both legend entries ('Duration trend · ms', 'p95 execution duration · ms', 'Mean execution duration · ms')
issues.fix: Keep the unit once, in the title, and shorten the legend entries to 'p95' / 'Mean'

issues.element: Pager shows 'Page 1' under 3 rows while the header says '128 retained events'. The page count and row range are missing
issues.fix: Show 'Rows 1–3 of 128 · Page 1 of 43' (or similar) beside Previous/Next

issues.element: Cell sub-captions 'Usage presence reported', 'Unavailable / Unpriced' (two words for one fact) and 'Explicit zero rate' are internal jargon
issues.fix: Use 'Provider-reported', a single 'Unpriced model' in muted ink, and 'Rate set to $0'

issues.element: Row 'Details' buttons and the Previous/Next pager use ~15px text with tall padding, larger than every toolbar button (13px)
issues.fix: Use the toolbar's secondary-button size for Details and the pager

issues.element: Failed outcome shows a bare '429' status code
issues.fix: Add the meaning: '429 · rate limited'

issues.element: The 'Reference: current configured model rates…' note stops ~290px short of the right edge while the Model Rates card below runs full width
issues.fix: Make the note span the full content width like every other card, or put it inside the Model Rates card

issues.element: 'current configured rates' appears in the top note and again in the caption 'USD per million tokens · current configured rates · — means no configured rate.'
issues.fix: Keep it once. Caption: 'USD per million tokens · — = no rate configured'

issues.element: Amber warning 'Model catalog unavailable for Offline synthetic source; registrations may be incomplete.' gives no next step, and 'Offline' is capitalised mid-sentence
issues.fix: Add the action, e.g. '…Reconnect the source in AI Providers to load its catalog', and lower-case 'offline'

issues.element: Billing model cell 'Not reported / unavailable' uses two hedges for one state
issues.fix: Use one term, 'Not reported', the same wording as other missing-value cells

issues.element: With 0 events, the Estimated cost and p95 duration tiles say 'Unavailable / No range total', which suggests a measurement fault rather than zero activity
issues.fix: Show '$0.00' for cost and '—' with 'No events' for duration, so 'Unavailable' is kept for data that is truly missing

issues.element: Empty banner says 'Choose a longer range to look further back.' but offers no control
issues.fix: Add a one-click 'Show last 7 days' button inside the banner

issues.element: Failed events tile reads '0 / of 0 events'
issues.fix: Hide the 'of N events' caption when N is 0

issues.element: KPI tiles say 'Unavailable / No range total' and the charts say 'No measured values in this interval.' with no cause. 'interval' also clashes with 'range' used everywhere else
issues.fix: Say why ('Providers did not report duration for these 128 events') and use 'range' consistently

issues.element: 'View data table' disclosure is still offered under charts that have no values
issues.fix: Hide it (or disable it with 'No rows') when the series is empty

issues.element: 'The local analytics dataset is not configured or is temporarily unavailable. Check the server dataset binding, then retry.' hedges between two causes and uses jargon ('dataset binding')
issues.fix: Tell the two cases apart if the API allows it. Otherwise name the actual setting/file to check and link to Config Panel, e.g. 'Set usage-statistics storage in Config Panel'

issues.element: Retry in the error card and Refresh in the toolbar do the same thing, and the filters stay enabled even though nothing can load
issues.fix: Disable the filter row (or dim it) while in error, and keep Retry as the single recovery action

issues.element: Loading state is a single 'Loading analytics...' text bar, so the page jumps when 8 KPI tiles and a 300px chart arrive
issues.fix: Render skeleton KPI tiles and a chart-height placeholder in the final grid, and use a true ellipsis character

regressions: overview/tokens at 1366x768 (and 1024): the new segmented toolbar wraps Refresh onto its own row beneath the time-range pills. In r11 Refresh sat inline with Apply/Clear filters. The chart is still fully visible at 1366, but the toolbar now has a stray orphan row.
reference_gaps: No 'Custom' range pill to close the time-range group, as the reference does
Bucket group offers only Auto / Hourly / Daily. The reference also has finer buckets (1 Min, 15 Min), with unavailable ones shown disabled rather than omitted
Search shares a row with Apply and the filters. The reference gives search its own full-width row with filters below, and needs no separate Apply button
Filters are native <select> controls with OS chevrons. The reference uses styled dropdowns that match the pill height and radius
No auto-refresh indicator (the reference's '(6s)' status pill) next to Refresh
No 'Show advanced filters' disclosure. All filters are always shown
